name: Asriel
overview: Asriel is a male figure from the tribe of Manasseh, identified specifically as the son of Manasseh. His mention in Scripture is concise, with no additional notes or details provided beyond his lineage. This establishes him as a part of the genealogical record within the tribe of Manasseh.
namesAndTitles: The name Asriel means 'G-d has filled with joy' or '[the object of] joy is G-d,' reflecting a meaningful theophoric element common in Hebrew names. This reveals a connection to God’s joy or the joy found in God, highlighting the spiritual significance embedded in his name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Asriel as the son of Manasseh, situating him within the tribal lineage of Manasseh. Beyond this father-son relationship, no further family connections are documented in the biblical text provided.
scriptureSignificance: Asriel’s significance lies primarily in his role as a genealogical figure within the tribe of Manasseh. His mention helps to preserve the lineage and tribal identity important to the biblical narrative. Though not highlighted for specific deeds or events, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving His people through generations.
